Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 24940 of 2023
Applicant :- Gaurav Alias Gyanendra Singh
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Reena Pal,Adarsh Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

The present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to quash the impugned charge sheet dated 22.03.2021, arising out of Case Crime No. 261 of 2020, under Sections 354B, 504, 506, 376, 511 IPC, Police Station Ahmadgarh, District Bulandshahr.
Submission of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The present prosecution has been launched only to harass the applicant which is abuse in the eye of law.
Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer and submitted that offence for the aforesaid sections are made out against the applicant.

The defence taken by the learned counsel for the applicant,

sentences.text: Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, after perusing the entire record and having considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, I am of the view that no case is made out to interfere with the impugned charge-sheet.
As per the allegation made in the F.I.R. as well as in the statement made by the prosecutrix under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., it cannot be said that no cognizable offence is made out.
No case for interference for invoking inherent power under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is made out.
Thus, the prayer made in the application is refused.
With the aforesaid observations, the application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed.
However, if the applicant applies for regular bail, the same shall be considered and decided in view of settled legal proposition of law.
